event_chain.summary: Employee Microsoft account compromised; files stolen

summary: On January 27, 2026 an unauthorized actor compromised an employee's Microsoft account at hospitality and food service company Delaware North and stole files. The company identified the suspicious activity the next day; a review completed on May 28 found the files contained names, driver's license or state ID numbers and, per a Texas attorney general report, Social Security numbers. Delaware North began notifying affected people on June 5, 2026.
